explanation: A title for God that expresses his sovereignty and power over all.
An awe or reverence for God, based on recognition of his greatness and holy nature.
A place to seek protection and safety; in this context, it means trusting in God for security and comfort.
To express gratitude, honor, and respect to God for his goodness and grace.
Those who live in accordance with God's will and moral standards, and are therefore regarded as righteous in his sight.
To be set free from a difficult or dangerous situation, often used of God's intervention to rescue people from distress.
A divine messenger and servant of God, who carries out his will and helps people in need.
A person who is crushed or humbled, often due to suffering or adversity. In this context, it refers to God's care for those who suffer.
